question: Who among the following opened his dance school by the name ‘Kalashram’?
solution:
The correct answer is ​**Birju Maharaj.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birju Maharaj**

 
 
• In the district of** Allahabad**, Maharaj was born Brijmohan Nath Mishra on **February 4, 1938,** into a Hindu Brahmin family.
 
• He was a descendant of the **Kathak dancers** who belonged to the Maharaj family, which also included his father and guru,** Acchan Maharaj**, as well as his two uncles, **Shambhu Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj.**
 
• He led the latter for a few years before** retiring in 1998** and opening his own dance school,** Kalashram,** in Delhi as well.
 
• At the **Sangeet Bharti** in New Delhi, Maharaj began teaching the dance form when he was** thirteen years old.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sundar Prasad**

 
 
• ​Pandit Sunder Prasad was a guru (teacher) in the **Jaipur Gharana** of the Indian classical dance form Kathak. He **passed away** on** May 29, 1970.**
 
• His father, **Pandit Chunnilal**, of the Jaipur Gharana, taught him.
 
• He moved to **Chennai** after teaching Kathak Dance for almost **30 years in Mumbai.** In** 1958**, the** Natak Academy of Delhi** honoured him.
 
 
 
• **Mohanrao Kallianpurkar**
 
 
• Mohanrao Shankarao Kallianpurkar; Born in **Karnataka** on** August 12, 1913**, he **died on December 1, 1985**. He is regarded as one of the **best scholars** and teachers of the Kathak dance form.
 
• He was hired as a Kathak teacher in **1939 at the Marris College of Music**, which later became the **Bhatkhande Music Institute in Lucknow**. He worked there until **1967** when he retired.
 
 
 
• **Shambhu Maharaj**
 
 
• Pandit Shambhu Maharaj was a Guru of the **Lucknow Gharana**, or school, of the Indian classical dance form Kathak. He was **born in 1910** and **died on November 4, 1970.**
 
• He attended the court of the **Nawab of Awadh**, **Wajid Ali Shah,** and was **Kalka Prasad Maharaj's youngest son.**
 
• ​In** 1967**, he received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** Fellowship, and in **1958**, he received** the Padmashri.**
